findings.message: AC-1 makes `ownerLabel` the one rule for what an ownerless proposal's owner reads as, but the chat update card still writes its own fallback. Both the Owner line (95) and the From line (101) use `owner_name ?? "Unassigned"`. Before this change the card matched the screens; now, for a released or withdrawn proposal with no owner, the card says 'Unassigned' while the list, board and proposal page say 'Not recorded'. Fix: select `phase` and the withdrawn flag in the card's query and build both lines with `ownerLabel({ ownerUserId, ownerName, phase, withdrawn })`. Add a released row and a withdrawn row to the 118 table test that check the card's From/Owner value.
findings.scenario: Released FLT-188 has no owner. Ask amax to 'make Kasun Dias the owner of FLT-188'. The confirm card shows 'Owner: Unassigned → Kasun Dias' (or 'From: Unassigned'), while the proposals list and the proposal page show 'Not recorded' for the same record.

findings.message: AC-2 says the proposal page's Owner fact shows `ownerLabel`. Instead, the page repeats the branching inline (`needsOwner ? 'Unassigned' : hasNoOwner ? 'Not recorded' : name`), with the 'Not recorded' text written a second time. It agrees with `ownerLabel` today because it uses the same predicates, but a change to the wording would have to be made in two places. Fix: render `ownerLabel(p)` and choose only the style (warn chip or muted) with `needsOwner(p)` / `hasNoOwner(p)`.

`ownerLabel` is documented as "what every screen shows for a proposal's owner", but the chat confirm card for an owner change was not moved to it. `updateCard` in `modules/delivery/server/proposal-card.ts:95` and `:101` still prints `owner_name ?? "Unassigned"` on its Owner/From line. The 087 test (`proposal-agent.test.ts:127-128`) ties that From line to the same rule as the page, so it is part of the same class. Fix: have `updateCard` read phase and withdrawn and build the From/Owner value with `ownerLabel`. Add released and withdrawn rows to the 087 table.
findings.scenario: FLT-188 is released and has no owner. The proposal page shows "Not recorded". The person picks "Make me the owner of FLT-188", and the chat confirm card shows "From: Unassigned → To: you".

findings.message: 087 AC-1 made one rule for "has no owner": the Unassigned chip, the pin's "Make me the owner" offer, the agent's Suggested owner and its accept guard must agree on every row (`proposal-agent.test.ts:96-97,132`). This diff moves the chip and the count to `needsOwner`, which excludes released and withdrawn proposals. The agent already only suggests for open proposals and takes its suggestion back when one closes. But `proposalGated` still offers the owner action on `hasNoOwner`. The two rules now disagree on closed proposals. Fix: gate the offer on `needsOwner(p)`, or record in 118 that claiming credit on a shipped proposal is intended and test it.
findings.scenario: A withdrawn proposal has no owner. The Owner fact says muted "Not recorded", and the attention strip does not count it. Its pin still offers "Make me the owner of X" as an action.

findings.message: The AC-3 table calls the pure functions on hand-built `as unknown as ProposalRow` rows. It never renders the three screens AC-2 changed. If the Owner column, the board avatar or the page fact still printed "Unassigned" for released or withdrawn proposals, this test would stay green. Fix: extend the render table in `proposal-agent.test.ts` 087 AC1 with released and withdrawn ownerless rows, checking the muted "Not recorded" on the list, the page and the card.
